title: Document recursive limiter deadlocks
prompt: Document the recursive p-limit deadlock reported in the repository. Explain that calling the same `limit` function from work already running under that limiter can leave inner tasks waiting for a concurrency slot held by the outer task. Add a clear warning and recommend a separate limiter for inner work in both the `limit(fn, ...args)` README section and the callable `LimitFunction` documentation in index.d.ts. Keep this change documentation-only and preserve the runtime behavior and API. Run an appropriate check.
